title: Tinted Glass Will Shatter│遮光玻璃會碎裂
description: You must use a tool with the Silk Touch enchantment to dig through the light-blocking glass to make it drop; otherwise, it will drop amethyst shards.│你必須使用帶有精準採集附魔的工具挖掘遮光玻璃才能使其掉落；否則，它會掉落紫水晶碎片。
body:
# Introduce│介紹
In vanilla, Tinted Glass would drop itself whenever it was broken, unlike other glass which required a tool with the Silk Touch enchantment to be mined. This Data Pack has adjusted the game mechanics to address this issue; now, unless mined with a tool with the Silk Touch enchantment, only 1-2 Amethyst Shards will drop.│在原版中，遮光玻璃在任何情況被破壞都會掉落自身，而不像其他玻璃必須要使用帶有精準採集附魔的工具挖掘才會掉落。此資料包對於這個問題進行了遊戲機制上的調整；現在，除非使用帶有精準採集附魔的工具挖掘，否則只會掉落1~2個紫水晶碎片。
